definition: A process in which an output influences a later input or changes the process that produced it.
A limiting stage or resource that constrains the performance or flow of a larger system.
Multiple elements can support the same function, allowing the function to continue when one element is lost.
A boundary at which a change in an input or condition produces a different kind of response.
An action or exchange is answered by a corresponding action or exchange between participants.
A transformation leaves specified features or relationships unchanged.
